title: Wiesentalstraße, Leutenbach
description:
Lieblingswohnung! My Favorite Living-Space :-)
Landlady speaks German and English! Prolongation beyond July probably possible but not sure yet.

Hier schlafen Sie gut! 20 min nach Stuttgart HbF. Perfekt für Singles oder Pärchen. 
1 Schlafzimmer, 1 Wohnzimmer mit offenem Wohn-Ess-Bereich mit Küche, 1 Bad mit Badewanne, WC.
Parkettboden, Kaminofen (zusätzlich zur normalen Heizung, eher für die Gemütlichkeit). Garten und Terrasse.
 S-Bahn-Anschluss S3 (nach Stuttgart, zum Flughafen ohne Umsteigen oder Richtung Backnang) nur 600 m die Straße runter. Sehr gemütliches ruhiges Appartment, sehr komfortabel ausgestattet. Die Wohnung ist im EG eines regional typischen Hauses mit Garten.  Im 1. OG und DG freundliche, ruhige Mieter (Young Professionals). Parkplätze in der Strasse immer vorhanden, vor dem Haus auch (wer zuerst kommt....).   
Rauchen ist auf der Terrasse erlaubt. 
Unternehmen in der Nähe: Daimler, Bosch, Kärcher, Porsche, Harro Höfiger, Stihl,...
Rasenmähen (ab Frühling, wenn das Gras wächst) wäre Sache des Mieters.

Here you sleep well! 20 min. to Stuttgart Main Station. Perfect for Singles or young couples. 1 Bedroom, 1 Living-Room with open Dining-Kitchen-Living room, very comfortable. 1 Bathroom with bathtub, WC.
All rooms wooden floor. Terrace, garden. (Wooden terrace needs a little renovating, but very cosy. Way to garden possible to be outdoors even when it rains.
Public S-Bahn-Transport S3 directly to Stuttgart, Airport, Backnang at the end of the street (600 m).  Very quiet, complete and comfortably equipped. Flat is base/ground floor, roof and middle is long-term rented to a very quiet and friendly persons (Young Professionals). 
Parking in the street always possible, in front of the house as well (who comes first....).   Smoking is allowed on the terrace, or outside the house. Companies near: Bosch, Kärcher, Porsche, Harro Höfiger, Stihl,... Gardening is to be done by renter (lawn mowing when necessary).

title: Alosenweg, Stuttgart
description:
Very nice fully furnished flat with terrace in Stuttgart Hedelfingen.
Beautiful fully furnished 2-room flat (42m2) with terrace in a quiet location (vineyards) in Stuttgart Hedelfingen. Shopping facilities as well as public transport are within walking distance (3 minutes to U9,U13 - H Hedelfingen).
The living room with access to the separate terrace, is furnished with a sofa, an armchair, a table with 2 chairs and a lowboard with a smart TV.
Here you will also find the modern, fully equipped kitchenette with oven.
In the bedroom there is a single bed (140cm) , a wardrobe, a bedside table and a large shelf. If required, the furniture can be exchanged.
The modern daylight bathroom has a bathtub with shower device. The washing machine (toploader) is also located here. Additional storage space is provided by a storeroom with shelves in the flat. There is also space for a bicycle.
Warm rent: €1100 (In the indicated rent, which is for one person, the service charges are already included).

title: Obertürkheimer Straße, Esslingen
description:
In this newly renovated 5-room apartment with approx. 116 m2 of living space, modern shared rooms (WG rooms) are being created in a quiet yet central location in Esslingen-Mettingen.

The apartment has been fully refurbished and offers the highest level of comfort:
	•	Bright bathroom with modern shower (newly tiled)
	•	Additional guest WC
	•	High-quality built-in kitchen included
	•	Living areas with elegant laminate flooring
	•	New radiators in all rooms
	•	Triple-glazed windows for excellent energy efficiency
	•	Internet connection available

The apartment is located in a highly sought-after, quiet residential area in Esslingen-Mettingen (Obertürkheimerstraße).
All essential amenities such as supermarkets, bakeries, pharmacies, and a bus stop are within walking distance.
The surrounding vineyards and numerous walking and cycling paths offer great opportunities for relaxation in nature.
There is quick and easy access to both the Esslingen city center and Stuttgart.

description:

title: Endersbacher Straße, Beutelsbach
description:
Furnished 2-room apartment: bedroom, living/dining room with open kitchen (bar), bathroom with floor-level shower, storage room. 

The apartment is fully furnished, towels and bed linen are provided, and the kitchen is fully equipped (pots, dishes, cutlery, etc.). 

The apartment is a granny flat with a separate entrance and mailbox/doorbell system with intercom. Access is not barrier-free. 

All shutters are electric. Built in 2018. 

Wi-Fi included. 

The apartment has a parking space. 

All costs are included in the monthly rent (water, electricity, property tax, garbage fees, etc.). 

Underfloor heating, washing machine, dryer, ironing board and iron, vacuum cleaner, mop, broom. 

Kitchen: ceramic hob, extractor hood, oven, dishwasher, refrigerator, microwave, coffee machine, toaster, kettle

The apartment is in a quiet location, right next to the vineyards. There is a bakery with a café and a small shop in the village. Various restaurants are within walking distance. The bus stop is a 2-minute walk away.

Ideal for weekend commuters and students.
